text: 商务部：2026年1-9月，全国新设立外商投资企业47800家，同比下降2.3%；实际使用外资金额5488.1亿元人民币，同比下降4.3%。9月当月实际使用外资同比增长2.5%。
text_en: Ministry of Commerce: In January-September 2026, 47,800 foreign-invested enterprises were newly established nationwide, down 2.3% year on year; actual use of foreign capital amounted to RMB 548.81 billion, down 4.3% year on year. In September alone, actual use of foreign capital rose 2.5% year on year.
